script: The first photo of a black hole was revealed in 2019. It showed a glowing orange ring around a dark center. The black hole, in a galaxy called M87, weighs about six and a half billion Suns. The picture needed radio telescopes all over Earth working together. Together they acted like one telescope almost as big as our planet.
